items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Paul Barber, yeah, when he first came back from Lewis he joined me... And he joined my band and played with me.

ctx.x: Did Paul Barber never play with you? Well, yeah.
Paul Barber, I don't want to tell that to him. Paul Barber, yeah, when he first came back from Lewis he joined me.
I thought maybe he played with you in those days, in years gone by. Before? Yeah, with Eddie Marsh and George E. Bush.
